query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS model_metrics (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  tag VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  model_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'xgb_quantile',
  mae REAL,
  rmse REAL,
  mape REAL,
  bias REAL,
  r2 REAL,
  training_samples INTEGER,
  horizon INTEGER DEFAULT 48,
  trained_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dr_audit_log (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  event_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  program_id VARCHAR(64),
  ven_id VARCHAR(64),
  tag VARCHAR(128),
  setpoint_kw REAL,
  baseline_kw REAL,
  actual_kw REAL,
  deviation_kw REAL,
  curtailment_kw REAL,
  opcua_status VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  dispatched_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  confirmed_at TIMESTAMP,
  regulatory_ref VARCHAR(128),
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
